text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about that, Lady Luck. I went and 
tore down the fence you put up.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Locked potential dashes out into the 
untrodden wilderness. Into a divine world 
devoid of fences or guideposts.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That concludes this chapter of my past. 
Hm? "What happened after that," you ask?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You exist in this very present. The myth 
of destruction and succession continues 
endlessly.
